Usage: memoriahub backup verify [options]

Verify the local backup root against the catalog (existence, size, sha256)

Options:
  --deep             Hash EVERY file, not only the ones not yet proven
  --json             Emit NDJSON events instead of human output
  --concurrency <n>  Parallel hashing workers (default: 4)
  -h, --help         display help for command

By default verify stats every `present` item and fully hashes only the items
whose bytes have not been proven since they landed (downloaded since the last
verify, never verified, or previously failed). --deep hashes everything.

A missing file or a hash mismatch marks the item for re-download — the next
`memoriahub backup run` re-fetches it. Verify never deletes or moves anything.
Exits non-zero when any item failed.
